name: crimeStats
invariants: output.ok === false || output.result.clearanceRate === undefined || (Number.isFinite(output.result.clearanceRate) && output.result.clearanceRate >= 0 && output.result.clearanceRate <= 100)
output.ok === false || output.result.mostCommon === undefined || typeof output.result.mostCommon === 'string'
_note: SCOPE (S1, written per cross-check #70(d) — no scope statement existed at any layer before this build): the population is THE LENS'S OWN RECORDS plus staged workbench rows — the caller's Crime Map incidents (mapAddIncident store; a mapped incident carries no resolution state and counts as unresolved), the caller's cases on file (caseCreate store; a case counts as cleared when closed, bucketed under type 'case'), and any incidents staged in artifact.data. result.scope names this population in words and result.sources carries the three counts; the stats card renders the scope line with the figures. Before S1 the macro computed over staged artifact rows ONLY and presented the figures unscoped (review finding F3). clearanceRate = round(resolved/total*100) over the whole population; mostCommon = highest byType bucket; trend = total>100 ? 'high-volume' : 'normal'. EMPTY population (no records, no staged rows) returns the honest { message } prompt with scope + sources (NOT a fabricated 0% card) — the stats card only renders figures when totalIncidents is present. The CrimeStatsResult card renders trend/clearanceRate/totalIncidents/mostCommon/byType[{type,count}]/scope. Non-array incidents → staged rows ignored, never NaN.
